name: HydraScope MCP
description: Structural OpenCypher context graph, temporal SUPERSEDES decision lineage, and 4-axis brick ontology MCP server on HydraDB (kruschdev/HydraScope v0.1.1). Local pre-flight ontology answerability checks inherit Guard policy; HydraDB graph queries, vector-vs-graph comparisons, benchmark runs, decision supersession, and repository directory ingestion require review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Leave HYDRADB_GRAPH_URL and HYDRADB_BOLT_URI unset for local graph operation when you do not want HydraScope to contact a remote HydraDB instance.

Keep hydrascope_ingest_directory and hydrascope_supersede_decision on Review: ingest_directory reads local repository files and writes graph vertices/edges, and supersede_decision mutates decision lineage.
